description: Check whether a crypto address is at risk of a USDT (Tether) freeze or is already frozen. Covers Ethereum, Tron, Avalanche, Celo, Solana and TON. Returns risk level 0–3 (0 no risk, 1 freeze proposal open in Tether multisig, 2 second of three signatures collected, 3 blacklisted), recommended action, per-chain reasons, current USDT balance, open freeze proposals with execution probability, and past blacklist episodes. Use it before accepting, sending or holding USDT, for counterparty due diligence, or when a user asks whether a wallet is blacklisted/frozen by Tether.

address.description: Address: 0x… (Ethereum/Avalanche/Celo), T… (Tron), TON (EQ…/UQ…) or Solana base58.

lang.description: Language of texts in the result. Default: Russian unless the client prefers English.

live.description: Also read status and balance from a node right now (default true). false is faster.

name: check_address
title: Check USDT freeze risk
